record: HH16 one focused profile-overlay lifecycle regression

change.newTest: profile edit overlay remains local to this controller and reset clears it
change.scope: One test only; no production source, fixture/provider/runtime, renderer, app delegation, or Git change.

flow: Create real in-memory storage, fixture provider, counted provider wrappers that delegate unchanged, actual runtime/community/controller, and renderPublicSite callback.

Initialize and log in the seeded synthetic avery@fixture.test account with randomUUID ephemeral credentials; open the owner's profile and assert the actual emitted tree's local/no-public-service disclosure before save.

Open edit, use the controller updateDraft path for synthetic name/bio, then save. Compare all provider call counts, provider snapshot, runtime snapshot, full receipts, storage entries, and the actual PxC Part identities/value references plus serialized non-provider/non-function Part values across save.
Navigate through the same controller's public-profile alias and assert one actual public-profile fixture read merges the still-local overlay.

Create a fresh fixture provider/runtime/controller over the same storage; assert fixture session is restored but the original provider profile, not the overlay, is rendered. Then reset the original fixture and confirm reentry shows the original seed profile.

priorEvidenceQualification.E2201: The original runtimePartsChanged field compared only Part address/kind inventory and is not full Part-body equality; the original raw result/captures remain unchanged. This regression compares Part identity, value-reference identity, serializable value snapshots, provider/runtime snapshots, receipts, provider calls, and storage separately.
priorEvidenceQualification.E2202: H2's fresh-controller boundary reused the same runtime. This test creates a fresh provider and runtime over the same synthetic fixture storage, as distinct evidence.

expectedBehavior: First pass is expected: this protects intended preview behavior, not a product defect correction. No artificial RED run will be manufactured. A future behavior that writes profile data through a provider/runtime/storage path or changes the local-only disclosure should force review of this contract test.

proposedCommand.status: Prospective only; not executed pending root checkpoint GO.

capturePolicy: If root authorizes the focused test, preserve the first original stdout, stderr, start/end UTC, and exit captures exclusively. No automatic retry, test assertion weakening, extra test/build, or Git stage/commit/export/publication.
